hooks.name: Regenerate scene types

action.prompt: backend/app/schema.py changed. In the backend folder, using the .venv Python, run `python -m app.export_schema`. Then in the frontend folder run `npm run gen:types`. Report whether frontend/src/types/scene.gen.ts changed, and flag any frontend code that no longer type-checks (run `npx tsc --noEmit` in frontend).

hooks.description: Keeps the TypeScript DiagramScene type in sync with the Pydantic schema
